Narrative and Plans
Type 1 Zoning Narrative for
2801-2825 W. 24 Boulevard; 2424-2436 S. California Avenue
RT4 to B2-3

A. The applicant proposes one the subject property from RT4 to B2-3 to develop a 60
unit building that will incorporate a portion of the existing Assumption of the Blessed
Virgin Mary church/school building and add a new addition. Twenty-Nine (29) parking
spaces will be provided. There will be approximately 7,744 square feet of commercial
space and the building height will not exceed 78 feet. The subject property is a Transit-
Served Location based on proximity to the California Pink line station (approximately
2,456 feet) and 26" Street (approximately 910 feet).

In accordance with Section 17-3-0308, any new construction within 2,640 feet of a CTA
or METRA rail station entrance or exit must satisfy all of the following specific criteria.
The proposed project satisfies such criteria as noted below:

1. The project complies with the applicable standards of Section 17-10-0102-B.
©. This criterion is met because the subject property is a Transit-Served
Location as noted above.

2. The project complies with the standards and regulations of Section 17-3-0504,
except paragraph H if the project is not located along a pedestrian street and except
paragraph C if the land use is designated in a non-commercial use group, pertaining
to pedestrian streets and pedestrian retail streets, even if the project is not located along
a pedestrian street or a pedestrian retail street.

o This criterion is met. 24" Boulevard is not a pedestrian street and the
proposed land use is in a non-commercial use group, therefore,
paragraphs C and H do not apply.

o Paragraph B is met by the variation requested with this application.

© Paragraph D is met because the primary entrance is on 24" Boulevard.

o Paragraph E is not applicable.

© Paragraph F is met with the majority of parking to the rear of the
proposed building.

© Paragraph G is met because vehicle access comes from the alley.

o Paragraphs I and J are not applicable.

3. The project complies with the general goals set forth in the Transit Friendly
Development Guide: Station Area Typology, and any other station-specific plans,
designs or guidelines adopted by the Chicago Plan Commission.

© The Guide defines “Transit Friendly Development” as “Development
which is oriented towards and integrated with adjacent transit. The
development incorporates accessibility and connectivity and is a multiuse
mix of dense development that generates significant levels of transit
riders.” The proposed development is integrated with adjacent transit
and benefit from proximity to transit.

1906813.1

4. Residential building projects shall not have a number of parking spaces in excess
of 50% of the Minimum Automobile Parking Ratio for the applicable district listed in
Section 17-10-0207 with any fractional result rounded up to the next higher whole
number, unless additional parking spaces are approved as an administrative
adjustment under the provisions of Section 17-13-1003-EE.

© 29 parking spaces are proposed for 60 units.

5. The project complies with the Travel Demand Study and Management Plan
tules of the Chicago Department of Transportation. The City's Commissioner of
Transportation is authorized to issue Travel Demand Study and Management Plan rules
consistent with this section.

o The project will comply with these standards.

The project will also require the following relief:

(i) as per Type I Section 17-13-0303-D a reduction in the rear yard from 30 feet to 6’4’
feet in accordance with Section 17-13-1101-B;

(ii) as per Type I Section 17-13-0303-D a reduction in ground floor commercial space
from 9,637 square feet to 7,744 square feet in accordance with Sections 17-13-1101-A
and 17-13-1003-X;

(iii) as per Type I Section 17-13-0303-D, a variation to the Building Location standards
of Section 17-3-0504-B in accordance with Sections 17-13-1101-A and 17-13-1003-P;
and

(iv) an increase in maximum building height for Transit-Served Locations meeting
100% of the ARO requirement on-site permitted in accordance with Section 17-3-0408-

B (vi).
